prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent sixteen-pose animation sprite atlas for Crown & Kingdoms, a hand-painted medieval isometric RTS. Reference image supplies original character identity/materials only; ignore ALL neighboring fragments and background. Strict four columns by four rows on 1536x1024 landscape canvas, one complete connected HORSE AND RIDER in every cell. Same fixed 3/4 isometric view facing right, consistent person/horse/equipment, realistic painted materials, upper-left warm daylight. Full horse head, tail, FOUR hooves, rider head and entire weapon visible with generous empty margins inside every source cell. Real transparency, no terrain, labels, grid or watermarks. Natural horse/skin/leather/steel colours; blue cloak and saddle cloth for team recolouring. Top two rows frames0-7: eight sequential visibly distinct horse walking/trotting strides with alternating leading legs, bent knees, raised hooves and natural rider weight shift; anatomically correct horse, never camel. Bottom two rows frames8-15: eight weapon-action poses on planted horse; frame8 ready idle, frames9-11 aim/wind-up, frame12 impact/release, frames13-15 recovery/preparation, then loop. Keep hands, weapons and rider physically connected to horse. Body about 190 pixels high per cell, readable at 60 gameplay pixels. NO detached airborne ammunition, smoke clouds, extra limbs/weapons or cropped figures. Tiny transparent hoof contact shadow, no pixel art or flat icons. Character: original Mangudai mounted archer: warm-skinned moustached rider, tan/bronze conical cap, brown leather/light lamellar armour, cream trousers, blue cloak, quiver, brown horse with blue saddle blanket and leather tack. One compact curved wooden bow. Walk holding bow across torso. Action: nock/draw/aim, release at frame12 with hand by cheek and no flying arrow, recover/reach toward quiver. No lance, gun, sword or shield.
